answer: Deposits are visible in sable, and ledge reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 29% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an copycat cannot recycle one pool of capital across 111 aliases, and each one needs its own funded quill account. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 3 epochs. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
